sources.title: Audio or video URLs
sources.description: Public URLs of audio or video files: MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, OPUS, FLAC, MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI and more. Long files are split automatically. Files in your own Apify key-value store work too: set the store's access to "Anyone with ID can read" and use https://api.apify.com/v2/key-value-stores/<store ID>/records/<key>.

language.title: Language
language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the spoken language (en, uk, de, es, fr, pl, ru, ...). Leave empty to detect it automatically; setting it improves accuracy for short or noisy recordings.

quality.title: Model
quality.description: accurate = Whisper large-v3 (best for Ukrainian and other non-English languages); fast = Whisper large-v3-turbo. Same price.

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary hint
vocabulary.description: Optional names, terms and spellings that appear in the recording (e.g. "Lviv, Kyivstar, PrivatBank"). Helps the model spell them correctly.

subtitles.title: SRT and VTT subtitles
subtitles.description: Also save SRT and VTT subtitle files with download links (free).
